title: Organization Settings
description: General settings related to sales and pricing

validation.taxPercent: Tax percent must be between 0 and 100

pricingMode.title: Which price should be suggested on sale?
pricingMode.description: Choose which price the system should automatically suggest when a product is added to the cart at the POS terminal.

catalog.title: Catalog price
catalog.description: The fixed sale price set on the product card is suggested. Recommended, standard option.

average.title: Average cost
average.description: The current average cost of the warehouse cell (auto-calculated from purchases/receipts) is suggested as the sale price.

pricingMode.note: Note: this setting only chooses the customer-facing sale price. The average cost itself is independent of this setting — it is calculated only from purchase/receipt movements. You can switch between these modes as many times as you like: the average cost is never recalculated and the database is never affected.

taxPercent.title: Tax percent
taxPercent.description: The tax percent added to the sale total at the POS
taxPercent.label: Percent

announcement.title: Send announcement
announcement.description: When you update the program, send all staff a message with an image and a link — they'll see it under the bell icon in the header, and tapping it opens the given page.

receiptTemplates.linkDescription: Customize how the receipt looks — which columns show, where the total aligns
receiptTemplates.title: Receipt templates
receiptTemplates.description: Create multiple templates and mark one as default — POS and sales will print using that template.
